subject: Payment escrow & VAT ledger mismatch — supporting evidence requested
messages:
From: Elena Petrova <elena@novum-retail.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@novum-retail.com
Date: 2027-11-30T08:15:00Z
Subject: Funds held in escrow + VAT posting mismatch (invoice 2027-10-31)

Hi Sergio,

We're seeing a hold placed against payment for invoice 2027-10-31 (amount €162,400) in our accounts payable system — it shows as 'escrowed' on your side. Separately, our VAT ledger shows both the full VAT amount posted and then a second VAT reversal entry dated 2027-11-28; the net VAT on that invoice is unclear. The combination is preventing our finance team from reconciling the period closing.

Can you confirm:
- Why the payment is in escrow (policy/collection hold reason)
- Whether the reversal entry is internal to Redwood (e.g., provisional credit) or a true refund to Novum
- A transaction-level mapping from our invoice line items to the payments/allocations you have recorded (we need this for our auditors)

I've attached the invoice PDF and a ledger excerpt showing the two VAT lines. Please treat this as high priority — our month close is tomorrow and we need evidence to pass to internal audit.

Attachments: [Attachment: novum_invoice_20271031.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: novum_ledger_excerpt_20271129.csv (CSV)]

Thanks,
Elena Petrova
Head of Finance, Novum Retail
Elena.Petrova@novum-retail.com
+44 20 7321 4455

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Petrova <elena@novum-retail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-30T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Funds held in escrow + VAT posting mismatch (invoice 2027-10-31)

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and for the attachments. I'm sorry for the inconvenience at month close. I'm looping in Ben (your account lead) and Kimberly (billing operations) so we can pull the required transaction evidence.

Quick answers before we gather the full artifacts:
- Escrow/hold: The payment was moved to an escrow state after our collections automation detected an unexpected token-count variance for the invoice period. That triggered an operations hold pending a short billing review. We should be able to surface the rule and the review note.
- VAT reversal: Preliminary look indicates an internal provisional VAT adjustment (we issued a provisional credit while we investigate a suspected duplicate session attribution). It did not go to the bank as a payout; it was a ledger entry on our side. We'll confirm.

Requested deliverables (we'll aim to have these in the next 24–36 hours):
- Per-line transaction mapping (CSV) aligning invoice line items to request IDs / session IDs
- Sampling of request traces showing token counts for the disputed window
- Audit note explaining the escrow trigger and whether a provisional credit was applied
- Confirmation of whether a customer-facing refund was issued

Ben: can you confirm whether we offered Novum a provisional credit and surface the collections review note?
Kimberly: please pull the transaction mapping and a short export of the VAT journal entries for this invoice. Mark for priority.

Elena — we'd like to propose a 30-minute call to walk through the artifacts once they're ready. Are you available 11:00–13:00 UTC tomorrow?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tx-mapping-20271130.csv (to follow from internal)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elena Petrova <elena@novum-retail.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-30T13:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Funds held in escrow + VAT posting mismatch (invoice 2027-10-31)

Elena — looping in with an initial data drop and a couple clarifying questions. I'm Ben, your AM on this account.

Please find an attached preliminary mapping (CSV) that links invoice lines to our internal payment allocations and request groupings. This is an export from our billing system and is meant as an interim artifact while Kim pulls the full session traces.

Attachments: [Attachment: tx-mapping-20271130.csv (CSV)]

Two quick asks from our side to ensure the mapping reconciles cleanly:
1) Can you confirm the VAT registration number you used when paying this invoice? Our VAT posting logic can differ across EU entities and we want to ensure we match the correct entity in our journal.
2) If Novum's AP system shows a different beneficiary reference (e.g., PO vs invoice number), please share that string so we can align the payment reference.

We're treating the escrow as investigatory — the payment itself is safe and we will not initiate a refund to the bank unless we confirm a true overpayment. If we find we issued an internal provisional credit in error we will rescind the provisional and either (a) release the payment to clear your AP hold or (b) issue a formal refund depending on what the audit requires.

Can you do 11:30 UTC tomorrow for a review call? If that doesn't work, propose two options and we'll pick one.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Elena Petrova <elena@novum-retail.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@novum-retail.com
Date: 2027-12-01T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Funds held in escrow + VAT posting mismatch (invoice 2027-10-31)

Hi Ben / Sergio — thanks for the rapid responses and the CSV.

VAT number is GB999888777. AP shows beneficiary reference: NOVUM-PO-7721 / INV-20271031. I've attached a short export from our ledger showing the two VAT lines and the bank payment status.

We can do 11:30 UTC tomorrow for a call — please send a calendar invite and a dial-in. Our expectation is a concrete timeline for either (1) releasing the escrow so we can close the period, or (2) a formal correction/refund path with evidence for our auditors.

Attachments: [Attachment: novum_additional_ledger_20271130.csv (CSV)]

Regards,
Elena
